Right now, 200 million African entrepreneurs face discrimination in global payment systems. Stripe operates in only 46 countries, excluding 76% of the world. PayPal restricts withdrawals in most African markets. Traditional bank transfers incur fees of 8-15% and take up to 7 days to settle. This isn't a technology problem; it's discrimination based on geography.

Our Solution
Syka provides African businesses with the same payment infrastructure available in San Francisco or London:
1. Collect payments globally via payment links, invoicing, and APIs
2. Send payments instantly to suppliers, teams, and vendors worldwide
3. Store value safely in USDT/USDC to protect against currency volatility
4. Manage multi-currency treasury with real-time visibility and forecasting

All at 0.75% transaction fees with instant settlement, no geographic restrictions, no hidden charges, no arbitrary account freezes.
